newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain savings banks eye Argentaria - CECA.
newsitem.headline: Spain savings banks eye Argentaria - CECA.

text.p: The president of the Spanish Confederation of Savings Banks (CECA), Braulio Medel, said on Tuesday some savings banks were interested in participating in the next state stake sale in Argentaria.

"I think that there will be interest at savings banks to participate in some of the large coming privatisations. Among these, one would have to include Argentaria", he told a savings banks conference.

Argentaria, formed in 1991 in a merger of six state-owned banks and savings banks and still 29.2 percent state-owned, is scheduled for further privatisation this year although no specific dates have been set.
According to Medel, the entry of savings banks into Argentaria would combine "business with social interests".
